tracks.title: 媒人喙糊瘰瘰 Muê-lâng-tshuì hôo-lui-lui
tracks.subject: A village matchmaker tells the groom's family that the girl eats very little and the girl's family that the boy hardly talks, then at the first meeting he talks nonstop and she eats nonstop and they suit perfectly.

tracks.title: りんごは十円玉の大きさ
tracks.genre: Tohoku minyo-pop (Tsugaru jonkara-bushi feel, shamisen with taiko)
tracks.subject: A nervous office worker in a Hirosaki tattoo studio asks an old woman tattooist for an apple the size of a 100-yen coin on his forearm, and she counts the needle pricks to a shamisen beat to keep him from flinching
